column3: Mārī amd avaruṅg dhan pāyāknā siten.
column4: Then he them-to property dividing gave.

column3: Mārī kōnnūṅg divasānī tsinnām bālā attānā ghumkāknā laya dhāv seden.
column4: Then some in-days he-younger son all collecting very far went.

column3: Attīn amd mājiltālā tān jiṅgī uḍāpten.
column4: There he riotously his property squandered.

column3: Mārī amd attānā kharchipten, add muluk mahāg paṭṭīn.
column4: Then he all spent, that country famine fell.

column3: Addī vakhōt amd ad muluk ōkōn māsan-āttin setnā tākten.
column4: That time he that country(-of) one man-with going lived.

column3: Amd amnuṅg turel kāyeṅg tānet vegāḍuṅg pānākten.
column4: He him swine to-feed his field-to sent.

column3: Addī vakhōt turel sōse tinhā ādnāḍ amd pōṭā niḍinā anāṅg amnun vāṭīltīn.
column4: That time swine husks ate those-from he belly fill thus him-to it-appeared.

column3: Mārī amd avaletnā enten, ‘amnet ambān māsuruṅg pheret īpāṭe aṇḍā, ān kārut tikhātūn. Ān sūltnā am-bānāṅg serātūn amnuṅg yenātūn, “bā, ān diyamnet innet muṭt pāp kāktān. In-dīn-tānāt innet bālā enet lāṅg tōten. Innet ōkōn tsākarī-parmān īḍ.”’
column4: Then he coming-to-senses said, ‘my father’s servants-to much bread is, I with-hunger die. I arising my-father-near will-go him-to will-say, “father, I God-of thy in-presence sin did. This-day-from thy son to-say worthy am-not. Thy one servant-like keep.”’

column3: Mārī amd sūltnā tān bānāṅg sedden.
column4: Then he arising his father-to went.

column3: Mārī amd dhāv aṇḍān ittet amnet tāk ōltnā, lōbha vāttīn, amd tūltnā amne mākkun ārāgā-paṭṭīn amnet mukā samnet.
column4: Then he far is then his father- seeing, pity came, he running his neck-on fell his kiss took.

column3: Mārī bālā amd enten, ‘bā diyamnet innet muṭt ān pāp kāktān. Indintānāt innet bālā enet-lāṅg tōten.’
column4: Then son that said, ‘father God-of thy before I sin did. Henceforward thy son to-say-proper am-not.’

column3: Mārī bān māsaruṅg iṭten, ‘aval āṅgī kōtnā adn tōḍeṅg, amnet kīt mundī, gēṭṭāt kēḍl tōḍūr. Mārī ān tintnā anand kākātūn. Kāre imd annet kīke tikt-āṇḍen, amd tiriknā pānām-edden; bhulīlta-āṇḍen, amd ōpāṭen.’
column4: Then the-father servants-to said, ‘good robe bringing that put-on, his hand-on ring, foot-on shoes put. Then I eating merry will-make. Because this my son had-died, he again life-came; lost-was, he was-found.’

column3: Id vakhōt amnet vaḍlāk bālā vegāṭ āṇḍen.
column4: This time his big son field-in was.

column3: Id vakōt māsūrtānāt ōkōn kukten amd veltōlten, ‘id tānaden?’
column4: This time servants-in-from one called he asked, ‘this what?’

column3: Amd amnu iṭten, ‘innet tōren vāttāṇḍān. Amd im bānu khuśālīnāḍ miḷālten. Amd mārī laī tineṅg-unākāt kākten.’
column4: He him-to said, ‘thy younger-brother come-is. He your father-to safety-in met. He then much feast made.’

column3: Mārī amd kātiṅg vātnā ōpāl seren.
column4: Then he anger-in coming inside went-not.

column3: Mārī bān vākāl vātnā amnu kārapeṅg lāgten.
column4: Then father outside coming him to-entreat began.

column3: Amd bānuṅg tirik enten, ‘ōlūr, ān iṅgeḍ varsa innet tsākarī kākātūn. Innet mān ān ephuṇḍī mōḍīp-tōten. Mārī ān annet sōbatyāg-barōbar anand kākeṅg ōkōd kōve si-tōten. Amd innet dhan pillāveṭṭā tintaruśiten, amd innet bālā vāttīn-āphuṇḍ nīv aduṅg-sāṭī laī tineṅg-unākāt kāk-āṇḍātīv.’
column4: He father-to back said, ‘see, I so-many years thy service do. Thy order I ever broke-not. And I my friends-with merry to-make one kid gavest-not. He thy property harlots eat-made, that thy child came-then thou it-for big feast making-art.’

column3: Āphuṇḍ amd amnun enten, ‘bālā, iv bāremās ana-veṭā āṇḍātīv; an attānā jiṅgī innitī āṇḍāt. Anand kāken id barōbar. Imde innet tōren tikt-āṇḍen, amd tiriknā pānām-eden; bhulīlta āṇḍen, amd ōpāṭen.’
column4: Then he him-to said, ‘son, thou always me-with art; my all property thine-only is. Merry to-make this proper. This thy younger-brother dead-was, he again life-came; lost was, he was-found.’

column3: Sinnām bālā bāpam muṭten, ‘bā, jiṅgānī anya hissā vāṭīp-kō.’
column4: The-younger son the-father-to said, ‘father, property(-of) my share divide-give.’

column3: Sinnām bālā jiṅgānī miḷāpten, dusrē ūru dhāu sedden, udhaḷvārī jiṅgānī attēk nās-gakten.
column4: The-younger son property gathered, other village far went, riotously property all destroyed-made.

column3: Mārī turel poṭṭa tīniṅg uttel, avande, ‘poṭṭa ān tyalātūn ipāt.’
column4: Then swine husks to-eat began, he, ‘husks I will-eat bread.’

column3: Avandun mārī sūd vattīn, ‘anye bāpne yallāt naukarnā pōṭāṅg ipāt puṭtād. Ān kāran tiksātan. Ān bāpam-phōkān sāhādūn bāpam moḍātūn, “bā, inna samōr diyām hukum puṭtān, pāp aktān. Innen bālā inne-kādūn anuṅg lajjā vahā. Anuṅg chākardār-laṅgānu āp.”’
column4: Him-to then sense came, ‘my father’s house-in servants-of belly-for bread is-got. I with-hunger die. I father-near having-gone father-to will-say, “father, thy before God’s command I-broke, sin I-did. Thy son having-said me-to shame comes. Me servant-like make.”’

column3: Bāp keiken ōlten dhāvād, avadūn mayā vattīn.
column4: The-father the-son saw distance-from, him-to pity came.

column3: Saddan keiken mākad paṭṭen, avande mukkā samten.
column4: Having-gone son’s neck-on fell, his kiss took.

column3: Mārī bālā muṭten, ‘bā, inna samōr diyām hukum puṭtān, pāp aktān. Innen bālā innekādūn anuṅg lajjā vahā.’
column4: Then son said, ‘father, thy before God’s command I-broke, sin I-did. Thy son having-said me-to shame comes.’

column3: Tāk jharān gaḍyākūn kōkten, gaḍyākūn iṭten, ‘dhaḍāpan āṅgē ivande mēnōt tepp. Ivande keit uṅgāram tapp, gēṭṭāt kērīkuḷ tapp.’
column4: The-father quickly servants called, servants-to said, ‘good cloth this-of body-on put. This-of hand-on ring put, foot-on shoes put.’

column3: Mārī avand majjā ākī ukatten, ‘anya bālā tiktānden prānām-etten; bālā gavāṭ-aṇḍen, ōmbāten.’
column4: Then he merry to-make began, ‘my son dead-man to-life-came; my-son lost-was, was-found.’

column3: Avan iṭten, ‘inna tōren vatten; avan bēs vatten; tineṅg akten.’
column4: He said, ‘thy younger-brother came; he well came; feast he-made.’

column3: Avande bāp vākāl kurten bālān samjipsān.
column4: His father outside came the-son entreated.

column3: Avand bāpku muṭten, ‘ān iniṅg varsha iniṅg dhandā gaksātan; inna hukum murken. Anya dōstā barābar majjā gakten mēkē siyaṅg-tōdī. Avand innen keike nās-gakten, kasbirā paisā seiten, avan vatten, avadūn tiniṅg aktīv.’
column4: He the-father-to said, ‘I so-many years thee-to service I-do; thy order broke-not. My friends with merry to-make goat gavest-not. That thy son destroyed-made, harlots(-to) money gave, he came, him-for feast madest.’

column3: Mārī avan muṭten, ‘nī anya barābar aṇḍātīv. Anya jiṅgānī inyetī yandīn. Anand gaktat pāijē. Anya bālā tiktānden, pānām-etten; bāl gavāṭ-aṇḍen, ōmbāten.’
column4: Then he said, ‘thou me with art. My property thine is. Merry to-make is-proper. My son dead-man, to-life-came; son lost-was, was-found.’
